Thanks Lena — great data to start with. Confirming we are locking Wed May 20, 14:00–14:45 PT. Calendar invite sent (includes a short pre-read and an Ops checklist to speed the session).

Prep items for the call (quick bullets):
- Confirm SLA needs (p99 latency target) and any hard max latency.
- Clarify the fraction of requests that are cacheable/prefix-stable.
- Provide any expected concurrency from orchestrator (how many parallel users/sessions).
- If you have synthetic traces, drop them into the Drive link in the invite before the call.

I’ve added two capacity scenarios we’ll validate:
A) Cost-priority: lower-cost quantized variant with 80% hit-rate cache assumptions.
B) Latency-priority: single-variant with aggressive batching and reserved GPU slots for steady-state.

If either of you foresee needing compliance / private deployment questions handled in the same slot, flag here and we’ll extend the call or loop in our security contact.
